observations: Photo 0 shows an industrial plastic bottle making machine in a workshop setting.
The machine has a control panel area and multiple blue side panels/cabinets.
No clear brand/model nameplate or readable specifications are visible in the photo.

claims.claim: Automatic Plastic Bottle Making Machine used in production to make PET plastic bottles of different...
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a plastic bottle making machine, but PET material type, bottle sizes/range, and “automatic” specs are not readable.

risks.risk: Exact machine type and capability (PET bottle blowing vs other plastic forming) and whether it truly makes bottles (not caps/preforms only).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the machine’s nameplate/spec label showing model/type, plus a short video of a full production cycle (load → blow → finished bottle).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used plastic bottle making machine with unknown output and uncertain production readiness.

risks.risk: Missing/incorrect tooling for specific bottle sizes (dies/molds) and whether “different” bottle sizes are supported.
risks.proof: Photos of included molds/dies (all sizes) laid out with labels, and a list of bottle sizes it can produce.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not including the full set of molds for multiple sizes (worst case: limited to one size).

risks.risk: Condition and working status (wear, leaks, heater/air system faults) not shown by a single exterior photo.
risks.proof: Video showing the machine running with stable operation and producing bottles, plus a recent test run record/invoice if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working (worst case: needs servicing/parts).

risks.risk: Power/voltage compatibility for Abuja (and electrical/control system condition).
risks.proof: Photo of electrical panel label (voltage/phase/Hz) and control system screen showing settings.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming unknown electrical specs and possible need for electrician conversion/repairs.

risks.risk: Spare parts availability and completeness (blowers, heaters, sensors, control boards).
risks.proof: Inventory photos of spare parts included and close-ups of key components (heater bands, sensors, control board).
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown spare parts included.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the machine nameplate/spec label (brand, model, year, voltage/phase, production capacity).
Short video of a full working cycle producing finished PET bottles (show output count and bottle quality).
Photos of all molds/dies included and a list of bottle sizes it can make.
Close-ups of control panel and any error/status screen during operation.
Photo of electrical panel label (voltage/phase/Hz) for Abuja compatibility.
response.reason: The photo confirms it’s an industrial plastic bottle making machine, but the key details needed to price it correctly (exact model/type, PET capability, included tooling, and working condition) are not readable or verifiable from the single image.
